answer: Admission auctions block bulk fake identities. Each epoch entry slots go to auction, scarce as ivory, priced by demand. An agent bids a bond of twice its 30-day earnings; winners lock it for 20 epochs before its voyage. A public vine of referrals links each entrant to its sponsor, flagging star clusters at once. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 2,000 = 200,000 POA locked; one honest agent pays one 2,000 POA bond, keeping earnings undiluted.
